inCameraSpotlight.heading: In-camera meeting detection
inCameraSpotlight.body: When parliamentary committees go closed-door, MapleSpike flags it automatically. Know which meetings are happening in secret, who's involved, and what topics are being discussed off the public record.

features.header: Every corner of Canadian governance tracked and connected
features.subtitle: Think of MapleSpike like a newsroom that never sleeps — it reads every public document so you don't have to, and shows you what matters.

parliament.title: Parliament — HoC & Senate
parliament.body: Every House of Commons and Senate committee meeting, every witness, every question. Detects in-camera sessions across both chambers so you know when debate goes behind closed doors.

gazette.title: Regulations — Canada Gazette
gazette.body: Proposed and final regulations from Canada Gazette Parts I+II. See what rules the government is planning before they become law — from environmental assessments to banking regulations.

influence.title: Corporate influence
influence.body: Lobbying reports, government contracts, and executive statements from Canada's biggest banks, telecoms, and media companies. See which companies meet with which departments and which contracts go to single bidders.

elections.title: Elections & Lobbying
elections.body: Third-party election advertising, political financing, and Ontario provincial lobbying. Track who's spending to influence voters and which organisations are lobbying at the provincial level.

networks.title: Influence networks
networks.body: From the UN to the WEF, from think tanks to NGOs — track organisations that shape Canadian policy. Monitor their government funding, their lobbying, and their connections to decision-makers.

oversight.title: Oversight & Courts
oversight.body: Audits from the OAG and PBO, Ethics Commissioner investigations, Competition Bureau actions, CRTC decisions, and CanLII court rulings. Full judicial and accountability tracking.

connect.title: Connect the dots
connect.body: The same people show up everywhere — sitting on committees, lobbying departments, winning contracts, appearing in court cases. MapleSpike links them together so you can see the full picture. Our signal detectors flag revolving doors, lobbying overlaps, and cross-jurisdictional connections automatically.

canadian.title: Built for Canadians, running in Canada
canadian.body: Every piece of information comes from official public sources — Parliament, the Lobbying Registry, the Canada Gazette, open court data, oversight bodies. Everything is verified and citable. No spin, no opinion, just the facts that are already public, organised so you can actually use them.

aiIntegration.header: Use it with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok — or your own code
aiIntegration.subtitle: MapleSpike connects to the AI tools you already use through the MCP standard. Add it once, ask questions about Canadian government in plain English.

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT
chatgpt.body: Connect via MCP in the ChatGPT desktop app. Ask questions about Canadian government in plain English and get sourced answers.

claude.title: Claude
claude.body: Native MCP support in Claude Desktop and Claude Code. Ask "what did the ethics committee discuss?" and get a full briefing with citations.

gemini.title: Gemini
gemini.body: Use MapleSpike as an MCP tool in Google AI Studio or the Gemini API. Cross-reference committee testimony with lobbying data in one query.

grok.title: Grok
grok.body: Connect through xAI's function-calling API. Ask Grok to check Canadian government data and get answers with source citations.

cursor.title: Cursor & Windsurf
cursor.body: Add the MCP endpoint URL to {cursorFile} or {windsurfFile}.

restApi.title: REST API
restApi.body: Direct HTTP access for backends, dashboards, and traditional apps.

apiRef.subtitle: Full API access with verified citations on every response. Every piece of data includes a source you can check.

pricing.subtitle: Start for free. Scale as you grow. No hidden fees, no contracts, no surprise bills.

free.name: Free
free.description: For curious Canadians, hobbyists, and trying it out.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For journalists, researchers, and small dev teams.

business.name: Business
business.description: For newsrooms, civic orgs, and production apps.

enterprise.body: Enterprise tier for government agencies and large organisations. Self-hosted option, unlimited calls, dedicated MCP server, full audit and provenance package with SLA.

footer.description: MapleSpike makes Canadian public data useful — for journalists, researchers, and anyone who wants to know what their government is doing. All data sourced from official government portals under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
